critique: The vermilion-and-green sculpture photo is genuinely commanding — the interlocking negative-space notches, the figure in matching green coat and red trousers dissolving into his own backdrop, the bleached concrete carrying two-thirds of the frame as real empty ground — and the high-key, spare brief is met at the image level. But the actual generated code contributes almost nothing: three small gradient blobs pinned to the lower corners read as smudges rather than an invented visual grammar, they sit outside the composition's own logic of hard orthogonal edges, and the 18px guinea pig at 57% opacity clipped in the bottom-right corner is invisible as either subject or wit — the anti-pattern mandate for new motion logic and texture language went unattempted.
